✨ midday | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide freelancers and solo entrepreneurs with an integrated platform for managing all aspects of their business operations, from tracking time and sending invoices to storing documents and analyzing finances.
✨ Key Features: • Time Tracking • Invoicing (upcoming) • Magic Inbox (invoice/receipt matching) • Vault (secure file storage) • Seamless Export (CSV)
📖 Summary: Midday is an AI-powered business assistant for freelancers and solo entrepreneurs, consolidating invoicing, time tracking, file storage, and financial overview into a single platform. It aims to streamline business operations by automating tasks like invoice matching and providing insightful financial analysis.
